values.note: City of Sopchoppy: 'Camping: $20'. Boat ramp $3 a day.

The rules speak of rigs 'that require hook-up to water and electricity' (amperage not stated). Gray-water and waste dumping is prohibited; campers use the dump station on Park Avenue outside the park, so the derived sewer value was cleared.

hookups.source: https://www.sopchoppy.org/uploads/5/4/8/4/5484400/campgroundrules2026.pdf (rule 3: 'no more than one rig that requires hook-up to water and electricity'; rule 9: 'Dumping of gray water and waste matter is prohibited. Please use the sanitary dump station located on Park Avenue outside the Park.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 26 RV sites plus primitive sites. Up to six people and two units per site, only one of them hooked up.

sites.source: https://www.sopchoppy.org/myron-b-hodge-city-park.html ('26 RV sites and primitive sites with bath facilities are available') + campground rules (rule 3), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Call (850) 962-5486 or the park host at (850) 756-0823; register with the park host on arrival (check-in after 1 p.m., check-out 11:30 a.m.). RV campers: 14 consecutive nights and 98 nights a calendar year at most, then 7 nights away before a new stay. Park gate closes 9 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.sopchoppy.org/myron-b-hodge-city-park.html (phone numbers) + https://www.sopchoppy.org/uploads/5/4/8/4/5484400/campgroundrules2026.pdf (rules 1, 5 '... for the entire reservation', 15 and 22; 'Myron B. Hodge City Park Host (850) 756-0823'), read 2026-10-21

note: City of Sopchoppy park on the Sopchoppy River, with a boat ramp, fishing piers, playgrounds and nature trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 camping and 26 RV sites on the city's page; added the 2026 campground rules (14-night RV limit, 98 nights a year, host registration, phone booking). Cleared the derived sewer (rules prohibit gray-water dumping and send campers to a dump station outside the park) and the derived 30-amp electric (no page gives an amperage; electric hookups exist, noted in hookups.note). Not stated: season, facilities beyond 'bath facilities'. Note: dropped hookup, price, booking and RV Life text.
